candidate_edge_types.target_description: Agent diagnostic reasoning that identifies the cause of the failure.

candidate_edge_types.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR_BLOCKER
candidate_edge_types.definition: A subsequent agent action modifies the execution environment to resolve a previously identified failure cause or missing prerequisite.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: A diagnosed failure cause or missing prerequisite of an earlier execution failure.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: An agent action that creates or restores the missing prerequisite and thereby attempts to remove the blocker.

candidate_edge_types.name: REEXECUTES_VERIFICATION_AFTER_REMEDIATION
candidate_edge_types.definition: After attempting to resolve the cause of an earlier failed verification, the agent re-executes that verification to determine whether the remediation succeeded.
candidate_edge_types.source_description: An earlier verification or test execution that failed because of a missing prerequisite or other blocker.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: A subsequent execution of the same verification after the agent has attempted to resolve the blocker.

candidate_edge_types.source_description: A successful verification or test result observed during execution.
candidate_edge_types.target_description: An agent task-completion action or completion request.
